lines.text: My cat is unhinged at midnight.

data.define: Used playfully for crazy but funny behavior.

example.text: My cat is unhinged at midnight.

misuse.text: Don't call your friend's mood 'unhinged' seriously.
misuse.why: It can sound like an insult.

publish.title: What does "unhinged" mean?
publish.value: Unhinged = Wild, silly and chaotic. Example: "My cat is unhinged at midnight." (very casual English, US).
